title: Oozy Malaysian Durian Satay
description: A creamy, winey, and adventurous Malaysian dish featuring grand marnier, perfect for snacking.

ingredients.name: Durian fruit
ingredients.notes: Choose ripe durians for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Grand Marnier liqueur
ingredients.notes: Add a twist of citrus to the dish.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Full-fat coconut milk for a creamy texture.

ingredients.name: Wooden skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak them in water for 30 minutes before use.

instructions: Soak the wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Cut the durian flesh into 1-inch cubes.
Thread the durian onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 375°F.
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the durian satay for 2-3 minutes per side, until slightly charred.
In a small saucepan, combine coconut milk, honey, and grand marnier.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Reduce the heat to low and let the glaze simmer for 5 minutes.
Brush the glaze onto the grilled durian satay while still warm.
Garnish with toasted coconut flakes and serve immediately.
